steps.title: Streak cells on YPD plate
steps.instruction: Streak cells from a frozen stock onto a freshly prepared YPD agar plate using a sterile pipette tip; incubate at 30 °C for at least 24 h.

steps.title: Inoculate overnight YPD culture
steps.instruction: In a 14 ml conical tube add 3 ml YPD liquid medium and inoculate with cells from the plate (single colonies not required for integrated strains); incubate at 30 °C, 180 rpm overnight.

steps.title: Switch to YNB medium with glucose
steps.instruction: In the morning pellet cells at 1,000 × g for 3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 3 ml YNB without carbon source; pellet again at 1,000 × g for 3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 3 ml YNB supplemented with 4 % glucose; incubate at 30 °C, 180 rpm for ~4 h.

steps.title: Wash and equilibrate cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 3 min, resuspend the pellet in 2 ml YNB with 4 % glucose; incubate at 30 °C, 180 rpm for about 10 min.

steps.title: Add cycloheximide
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl of 100 mg/ml cycloheximide solution (in EtOH) to reach a final concentration of 100 µg/ml; incubate 1 h at room temperature, protected from light, without shaking.

steps.title: Mount sample on slide
steps.instruction: Place 5 µl of the culture on a microscopy slide and cover with a 22 × 22 mm coverslip, avoiding any air bubbles.

steps.title: Locate cells for imaging
steps.instruction: Place the slide under the microscope with the coverslip on the objective; find a region containing 5–10 stationary cells at 100× magnification; set exposure times to 22 s for GFP and 7 s for mCherry to avoid detector saturation.

steps.title: Acquire pre‑bleach images
steps.instruction: Capture a brightfield and fluorescence image for each channel using the chosen exposure times; open the mercury lamp only for the duration of each exposure.

steps.title: Photobleach GFP
steps.instruction: Continuously illuminate the GFP wavelength until the region appears completely dark, then continue for an additional 1 min (total 3 min 40 s); immediately start the timer (time 0 min).

steps.title: Acquire GFP time‑course
steps.instruction: Acquire brightfield and GFP fluorescence images at time points 0, 7.5, 15, 25, 30, 40, 60, 90 and 120 min after bleaching.

steps.title: Photobleach mCherry
steps.instruction: Continuously illuminate the mCherry wavelength until the region is completely dark, then continue for an additional 1 min (total 4 min); immediately start the timer (time 0 min).

steps.title: Acquire mCherry time‑course
steps.instruction: Acquire brightfield and mCherry fluorescence images at the same time points as for GFP (0, 7.5, 15, 25, 30, 40, 60, 90, 120 min) following the order listed in Table 1.

steps.title: Convert images to TIFF
steps.instruction: Use AxioVision software to convert all .zvi files to open‑standard TIFF format.

steps.title: Measure cell fluorescence
steps.instruction: In ImageJ open the first unbleached brightfield image, draw an oval ROI around a cell; open the corresponding fluorescence image and restore the ROI (Shift+E); set measurements to ‘area’ and ‘integrated density’; press Ctrl+M to record values; repeat for every cell and time point for both channels.

steps.title: Measure background intensity
steps.instruction: Select random background areas around cells, record integrated density (S_bg); compute the average background sum intensity (S_Abg) and multiply by the pixel count N of the cell ROI to obtain I_bg = S_Abg × N.

steps.title: Background‑correct cell intensity
steps.instruction: Calculate I_cell = S_cell – I_bg for each measurement; average I_cell across all cells to obtain I_final and compute SD/SE as needed.

steps.title: Plot fluorescence over time
steps.instruction: Plot I_final versus experimental time for GFP and mCherry; include wild‑type autofluorescence controls; any signal above autofluorescence reflects mature fluorescent protein.

steps.title: Fit maturation curve (mCherry)
steps.instruction: In MATLAB create variables x (time) and y (post‑bleach intensity); open the Curve Fitting Toolbox, select custom equation I = I_bleach + I_rec × (1‑exp(‑t/t_mat)); assign x to X data and y to Y data, enable Auto fit, adjust start points if needed, and record fit parameters (e.g., I_rec = 4.3 × 10⁴ ± 3 × 10⁴, I_bleach = 5.2 × 10⁴ ± 2.5 × 10⁴, t_mat = 17 ± 10 min, R² = 0.7).

steps.title: Calculate dark fraction
steps.instruction: Divide I_rec by the autofluorescence‑corrected pre‑bleach intensity to obtain the proportion of immature protein (≈5 %).

steps.title: Prepare 50 % glucose solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 500 g glucose, add MilliQ water to 1 L, dissolve with magnetic stirrer and heating; autoclave 20 min at 121 °C.

steps.title: Prepare YPD agar with 4 % glucose
steps.instruction: Mix 5 g yeast extract, 10 g Bacto‑peptone, 10 g agar; add MilliQ water to 460 ml; autoclave 20 min at 121 °C; add 40 ml 50 % glucose; dispense ~25 ml per 92 mm plate, let solidify, store upside down at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare YPD liquid with 4 % glucose
steps.instruction: Mix 5 g yeast extract and 10 g Bacto‑peptone; add MilliQ water to 460 ml; autoclave 20 min at 121 °C; add 40 ml 50 % glucose.

steps.title: Prepare YNB liquid without glucose
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.7 g YNB (no amino acids, no (NH₄)₂SO₄), 0.79 g complete supplement, and 5 g (NH₄)₂SO₄ in 900 ml MilliQ water; adjust pH to 5.8‑6.0 with NaOH; bring volume to 1 000 ml with MilliQ water; autoclave 20 min at 121 °C.

steps.title: Prepare YNB liquid with 4 % glucose
steps.instruction: Prepare as for YNB without glucose, bring volume to 920 ml after autoclave, then add 80 ml 50 % glucose; autoclave as above.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mg/ml cycloheximide
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.5 g cycloheximide, dissolve in 5 ml absolute ethanol; aliquot and store at –20 °C.
